		print("🏮 [CHAR-CONTROLLER] Character manifest successfully.")

		end
	else
		reportIssue("LOAD_FAIL", "Character manifestation failed in world")

	pcall(function()
		Telemetry.dispatchPulse({

			success = success,
			usedFallback = usedFallback

	end)

-- LobbyController.luau
-- Handles join GUI, first-person camera lock, in-seat HUD, countdown, and glide

local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService        = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local LobbyController = {
	Name  = "LobbyController",
	State = {
		seated       = false,
		isHost       = false,
		gliding      = false,
		glideConn    = nil,
		camConn      = nil,
		inSeatUI     = nil,
		countdownGui = nil,
	},
}

local GLIDE_LIFT_MULTIPLIER = 0.9
local GLIDE_MAX_FALL_SPEED = 34
local GLIDE_STEER_POWER = 3.0
local GLIDE_MAX_HORIZONTAL_SPEED = 120

-- ── UI helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function clearUI(state, key)
	if state[key] then state[key]:Destroy(); state[key] = nil end
end

local function makeBtn(parent, text, pos, size, col, strokeCol)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size              = size or UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 44)
	btn.Position          = pos
	btn.AnchorPoint       = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	btn.Text              = text
	btn.TextSize          = 18
	btn.Font              = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextColor3        = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	btn.BackgroundColor3  = col or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
	btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	btn.Parent            = parent
	Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
	stroke.Color = strokeCol or Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)
	return btn
end

-- ── Join confirmation GUI ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function showJoinPrompt(seatIndex)
	local pg = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if not pg then return end

	-- Remove any existing join prompt
	local old = pg:FindFirstChild("Sovereign_LobbyJoin")
	if old then old:Destroy() end

	local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	sg.Name         = "Sovereign_LobbyJoin"
	sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
	sg.Parent       = pg

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Size               = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 160)
	panel.Position           = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	panel.AnchorPoint        = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	panel.BackgroundColor3   = Color3.fromRGB(10, 12, 20)
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	panel.Parent             = sg
	Instance.new("UICorner", panel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", panel)
	stroke.Color     = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)
	stroke.Thickness = 2

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size                = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
	title.Position            = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 14)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text                = "Join this seat?"
	title.TextSize            = 22
	title.Font                = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextColor3          = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 255)
	title.Parent              = panel

	local yes = makeBtn(panel, "Yes — Join",
		UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0.72, 0), UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 40),
		Color3.fromRGB(20, 90, 20), Color3.fromRGB(50, 200, 80))

	local no = makeBtn(panel, "No",
		UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 0.72, 0), UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 40),
		Color3.fromRGB(80, 20, 20), Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50))

	yes.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		sg:Destroy()
		ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_JoinResponse"):FireServer(seatIndex, true)
	end)
	no.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		sg:Destroy()
		ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_JoinResponse"):FireServer(seatIndex, false)
	end)
end

-- ── In-seat HUD ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function showSeatHUD(state, isHost)
	local pg = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if not pg then return end
	clearUI(state, "inSeatUI")

	local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	sg.Name         = "Sovereign_LobbyHUD"
	sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
	sg.Parent       = pg
	state.inSeatUI  = sg

	-- Exit button (bottom center)
	local exitBtn = makeBtn(sg, "Exit Lobby",
		UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.95, 0), UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 40),
		Color3.fromRGB(80, 20, 20), Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50))
	exitBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	exitBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_ExitSeat"):FireServer()
	end)

	-- Start Game button (host only, just above Exit)
	if isHost then
		local startBtn = makeBtn(sg, "Start Game",
			UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.87, 0), UDim2.new(0, 170, 0, 46),
			Color3.fromRGB(20, 110, 20), Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 100))
		startBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
		startBtn.TextSize = 20
		startBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_StartGame"):FireServer()
		end)
	end
end

-- ── Camera first-person lock ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function lockFirstPerson(state)
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	if state.camConn then state.camConn:Disconnect() end
	state.camConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local char = player.Character
		if not char then return end
		local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if head then camera.CFrame = head.CFrame end
	end)
end

local function unlockCamera(state)
	if state.camConn then state.camConn:Disconnect(); state.camConn = nil end
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
end

-- ── Countdown display ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function showCountdown(state, n)
	local pg = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if not pg then return end

	if not state.countdownGui then
		local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		sg.Name         = "Sovereign_Countdown"
		sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
		sg.Parent       = pg
		state.countdownGui = sg

		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		lbl.Name                    = "Number"
		lbl.Size                    = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 200)
		lbl.Position                = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.25, 0)
		lbl.BackgroundTransparency  = 1
		lbl.Font                    = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		lbl.TextSize                = 120
		lbl.TextColor3              = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 50)
		lbl.TextStrokeTransparency  = 0.3
		lbl.Parent                  = sg
	end

	local lbl = state.countdownGui:FindFirstChild("Number")
	if lbl then lbl.Text = n > 0 and tostring(n) or "GO!" end

	if n == 0 then
		task.delay(1, function() clearUI(state, "countdownGui") end)
	end
end

-- ── Glide mode ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function enableGlide(state)
	state.gliding = true
	unlockCamera(state)

	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hrp or not hum then return end

	-- Counter ~82% of gravity so player falls slowly
	local bf = Instance.new("BodyForce")
	bf.Name  = "GlideForce"
	bf.Force = Vector3.new(0, workspace.Gravity * hrp.AssemblyMass * GLIDE_LIFT_MULTIPLIER, 0)
	bf.Parent = hrp

	hum.WalkSpeed = 0  -- no ground movement while airborne

	if state.glideConn then state.glideConn:Disconnect() end
	state.glideConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not state.gliding then return end
		local c = player.Character
		if not c then return end
		local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not r then return end

		-- Land detection
		if r.Position.Y < 12 then
			state.gliding = false
			local gf = r:FindFirstChild("GlideForce")
			if gf then gf:Destroy() end
			local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if h then h.WalkSpeed = 32 end
			if state.glideConn then state.glideConn:Disconnect(); state.glideConn = nil end
			return
		end

		-- Platform-friendly steering: uses Humanoid.MoveDirection so touch controls,
		-- gamepad, and keyboard all drive glide movement without letter-key checks.
		local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local moveDir = (h and h.MoveDirection) or Vector3.zero
		local impulse = Vector3.new(moveDir.X, 0, moveDir.Z) * GLIDE_STEER_POWER

		local vel  = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		-- Preserve catapult momentum; do not heavily damp horizontal speed.
		local baseHorizontal = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z) * 0.998
		local hVel = baseHorizontal + impulse
		if hVel.Magnitude > GLIDE_MAX_HORIZONTAL_SPEED then
			hVel = hVel.Unit * GLIDE_MAX_HORIZONTAL_SPEED
		end

		local yVel = vel.Y
		if yVel < -GLIDE_MAX_FALL_SPEED then
			yVel = -GLIDE_MAX_FALL_SPEED
		end

		r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(hVel.X, yVel, hVel.Z)
	end)
end

-- ── Controller lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function LobbyController:Init()
	print("[LOBBY-CLIENT] Initialized.")
end

function LobbyController:Start()
	local RS = ReplicatedStorage

	RS:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_AskJoin").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(seatIndex)
		showJoinPrompt(seatIndex)
	end)

	-- Teleport onto the seat; Roblox native seat contact triggers the sit animation
	RS:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_DoSit").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(seat)
		local char = player.Character
		if not char then return end
		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end
		hrp.CFrame = seat.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, 0)
	end)

	RS:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_Seated").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(isHost)
		if self.State.seated then return end  -- already handled by Attribute signal
		self.State.seated = true
		self.State.isHost = isHost
		local pg = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
		if pg then
			local old = pg:FindFirstChild("Sovereign_LobbyJoin")
			if old then old:Destroy() end
		end
		lockFirstPerson(self.State)
		showSeatHUD(self.State, isHost)
	end)

	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("OMC_LobbySeated"):Connect(function()
		local seated = player:GetAttribute("OMC_LobbySeated")
		local isHost = player:GetAttribute("OMC_LobbyIsHost") == true
		if seated then
			if self.State.seated then return end
			self.State.seated = true
			self.State.isHost = isHost
			local pg = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
			if pg then
				local old = pg:FindFirstChild("Sovereign_LobbyJoin")
				if old then old:Destroy() end
			end
			lockFirstPerson(self.State)
			showSeatHUD(self.State, isHost)
		else
			self.State.seated = false
			self.State.isHost = false
			unlockCamera(self.State)
			clearUI(self.State, "inSeatUI")
		end
	end)

	RS:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_Unseated").OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
		self.State.seated = false
		self.State.isHost = false
		unlockCamera(self.State)
		clearUI(self.State, "inSeatUI")
		local char = player.Character
		if char then
			local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then hum.Sit = false end
		end
	end)

	RS:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_Countdown").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(n)
		showCountdown(self.State, n)
	end)

	RS:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_Launched").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(launchCF, launchVelocity)
		clearUI(self.State, "inSeatUI")
		self.State.seated = false

		-- Deterministic local ejection so launch is visible even if seat replication lags.
		unlockCamera(self.State)
		local char = player.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local seatWeld = char and char:FindFirstChild("SeatWeld", true)
		if seatWeld and seatWeld:IsA("Weld") then
			seatWeld:Destroy()
		end
		if hum then
			hum.Sit = false
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
		end
		if hrp then
			if typeof(launchCF) == "CFrame" then
				hrp.CFrame = launchCF
			end
			if typeof(launchVelocity) == "Vector3" then
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = launchVelocity
			end
		end

		enableGlide(self.State)
	end)
end

return LobbyController

--[=[
    SovereignMobilityController.luau
    Status: ARCHITECT MANIFEST
    Role: Client-side mobility enhancement (Double-Jump)
]=]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local MobilityController = {
	Config = {
		MAX_JUMPS = 2,
		JUMP_IMPULSE = 100,
	},
	State = {
		jumpCount = 0,
	},
}

function MobilityController:Init()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
		character = newCharacter
		self.State.jumpCount = 0
	end)
	
	UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid then return end
		
		local state = humanoid:GetState()
		
		if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
			self.State.jumpCount = 0
		elseif state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
			if self.State.jumpCount < self.Config.MAX_JUMPS - 1 then
				self.State.jumpCount += 1
				
				-- Apply Kinetic Impulse
				humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
				local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if hrp then
					hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
						hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X,
						self.Config.JUMP_IMPULSE,
						hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function MobilityController:Start()
	print("🏮 [MOBILITY] Double-Jump Active.")
end

return MobilityController

-- HousingService.luau
-- Abandoned neighborhood: road, flickering streetlights, 4 walkable houses

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local HousingService = {
	Name  = "HousingService",
	State = { folder = nil },
}

local FLOOR_Y = 0.5   -- matches dance floor tile surface
local HOUSE_Y = FLOOR_Y  -- everything sits at dance floor level

-- ── Part factory ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function mk(parent, size, cf, color, mat, canCollide)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Size       = size
	p.CFrame     = cf
	p.Color      = color
	p.Material   = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Anchored   = true
	p.CanCollide = canCollide ~= false
	p.CastShadow = true
	p.Parent     = parent
	return p
end

-- ── Wall builders ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- ZWall: face runs along Z axis, thickness along X
-- cx=fixed X pos, cy=vertical center, cz=Z center of wall
local function buildZWall(parent, cx, cy, cz, wW, wH, wT, col, mat, opening)
	local doorW, doorH = 6, 9
	local winW, winH, winSill = 5, 4, 3
	if opening == "door" then
		local lw = (wW - doorW) / 2
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, wH, lw),    CFrame.new(cx, cy, cz - doorW/2 - lw/2), col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, wH, lw),    CFrame.new(cx, cy, cz + doorW/2 + lw/2), col, mat)
		local hH = wH - doorH
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, hH, doorW), CFrame.new(cx, cy + wH/2 - hH/2, cz),    col, mat)
	elseif opening == "window" then
		local flY   = cy - wH/2
		local winCY = flY + winSill + winH/2
		local topH  = wH - winSill - winH
		local sw    = (wW - winW) / 2
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, winSill, wW), CFrame.new(cx, flY + winSill/2, cz),        col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, topH, wW),    CFrame.new(cx, cy + wH/2 - topH/2, cz),     col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, winH, sw),    CFrame.new(cx, winCY, cz - winW/2 - sw/2),  col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, winH, sw),    CFrame.new(cx, winCY, cz + winW/2 + sw/2),  col, mat)
	else
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, wH, wW), CFrame.new(cx, cy, cz), col, mat)
	end
end

-- XWall: face runs along X axis, thickness along Z
-- cx=X center, cy=vertical center, cz=fixed Z pos
local function buildXWall(parent, cx, cy, cz, wW, wH, wT, col, mat, opening)
	local doorW, doorH = 6, 9
	local winW, winH, winSill = 5, 4, 3
	if opening == "door" then
		local lw = (wW - doorW) / 2
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(lw, wH, wT),    CFrame.new(cx - doorW/2 - lw/2, cy, cz), col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(lw, wH, wT),    CFrame.new(cx + doorW/2 + lw/2, cy, cz), col, mat)
		local hH = wH - doorH
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(doorW, hH, wT), CFrame.new(cx, cy + wH/2 - hH/2, cz),    col, mat)
	elseif opening == "window" then
		local flY   = cy - wH/2
		local winCY = flY + winSill + winH/2
		local topH  = wH - winSill - winH
		local sw    = (wW - winW) / 2
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wW, winSill, wT), CFrame.new(cx, flY + winSill/2, cz),        col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wW, topH, wT),    CFrame.new(cx, cy + wH/2 - topH/2, cz),     col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(sw, winH, wT),    CFrame.new(cx - winW/2 - sw/2, winCY, cz),  col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(sw, winH, wT),    CFrame.new(cx + winW/2 + sw/2, winCY, cz),  col, mat)
	else
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wW, wH, wT), CFrame.new(cx, cy, cz), col, mat)
	end
end

-- ── Interior furnishings ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local function furnishBungalow(folder, cx, cz, W, D, H)
	-- Dining table

	local T      = 1.2
	local frontX = cx + frontSign * D/2
	local backX  = cx - frontSign * D/2
	local floorC = Color3.fromRGB(80, 65, 50)
	local floorM = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks
	local wallY  = HOUSE_Y + H/2

	-- Floor slab
	mk(folder, Vector3.new(D - T*2, 0.5, W - T*2), CFrame.new(cx, HOUSE_Y + 0.25, cz), floorC, floorM)

	-- Outer walls — one big open room, no internal divider
	buildZWall(folder, frontX, wallY, cz,   W,     H, T, wallColor, wallMat, "door")
	buildZWall(folder, backX,  wallY, cz,   W,     H, T, wallColor, wallMat, "window")
	buildXWall(folder, cx, wallY, cz - W/2, D-T*2, H, T, wallColor, wallMat, "window")
	buildXWall(folder, cx, wallY, cz + W/2, D-T*2, H, T, wallColor, wallMat, "window")

	pl.Range      = math.max(W, D) * 0.65

	mk(folder, Vector3.new(D + 3, 1.2, W + 3), CFrame.new(cx, HOUSE_Y + H + 0.6, cz),

local function buildRoad(folder)
	local ROAD_Y    = FLOOR_Y           -- road sits at dance floor level
	local ROAD_W    = 18
	local START_Z   = 220   -- just past dance floor edge (~Z=216)
	local END_Z     = 685   -- deep into the forest (3x original length)
	local ROAD_LEN  = END_Z - START_Z
	local ROAD_CZ   = (START_Z + END_Z) / 2
	local SIDE_W    = 5
	local ROAD_COL  = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 36)
	local SIDE_COL  = Color3.fromRGB(88, 86, 82)
	local CURB_COL  = Color3.fromRGB(155, 153, 148)

	-- Clear grass: go deep enough to remove all terrain at and above road level
	workspace.Terrain:FillBlock(
		CFrame.new(0, ROAD_Y + 2, ROAD_CZ),
		Vector3.new(34, 14, ROAD_LEN + 20),
		Enum.Material.Air
	)

	local SLAB = 5   -- part thickness; fills the cleared void so road doesn't float
	local ROAD_TOP = ROAD_Y + 0.25   -- desired road surface Y
	local SIDE_TOP = ROAD_Y + 0.5    -- sidewalk sits slightly higher

	-- Road surface (thick slab so it fills the void below)
	mk(folder, Vector3.new(ROAD_W, SLAB, ROAD_LEN),
		CFrame.new(0, ROAD_TOP - SLAB/2, ROAD_CZ), ROAD_COL, Enum.Material.Concrete)

	-- Sidewalks
	local sideXL = -(ROAD_W/2 + SIDE_W/2)
	local sideXR =  (ROAD_W/2 + SIDE_W/2)
	mk(folder, Vector3.new(SIDE_W, SLAB, ROAD_LEN), CFrame.new(sideXL, SIDE_TOP - SLAB/2, ROAD_CZ), SIDE_COL, Enum.Material.Concrete)
	mk(folder, Vector3.new(SIDE_W, SLAB, ROAD_LEN), CFrame.new(sideXR, SIDE_TOP - SLAB/2, ROAD_CZ), SIDE_COL, Enum.Material.Concrete)

	-- Curbs
	mk(folder, Vector3.new(0.5, SLAB, ROAD_LEN), CFrame.new(sideXL - SIDE_W/2, SIDE_TOP - SLAB/2, ROAD_CZ), CURB_COL, Enum.Material.Concrete)
	mk(folder, Vector3.new(0.5, SLAB, ROAD_LEN), CFrame.new(sideXR + SIDE_W/2, SIDE_TOP - SLAB/2, ROAD_CZ), CURB_COL, Enum.Material.Concrete)

	-- Dashed center line (one dash every 30 studs)
	local dashCount = math.floor(ROAD_LEN / 30)
	for i = 0, dashCount do
		mk(folder, Vector3.new(0.5, 0.55, 7),
			CFrame.new(0, ROAD_Y + 0.01, START_Z + 15 + i * 30),
			Color3.fromRGB(210, 190, 55), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false)
	end

	-- Cul-de-sac turnaround at road end
	workspace.Terrain:FillBlock(
		CFrame.new(0, ROAD_Y + 2, END_Z + 25),
		Vector3.new(90, 14, 70),
		Enum.Material.Air
	)
	mk(folder, Vector3.new(60, SLAB, 44),
		CFrame.new(0, ROAD_TOP - SLAB/2, END_Z + 22),
		ROAD_COL, Enum.Material.Concrete)
	mk(folder, Vector3.new(60, SLAB, 0.5), CFrame.new(0,  SIDE_TOP - SLAB/2, END_Z+1),    CURB_COL, Enum.Material.Concrete)
	mk(folder, Vector3.new(0.5, SLAB, 44), CFrame.new(-30, SIDE_TOP - SLAB/2, END_Z+22),  CURB_COL, Enum.Material.Concrete)
	mk(folder, Vector3.new(0.5, SLAB, 44), CFrame.new( 30, SIDE_TOP - SLAB/2, END_Z+22),  CURB_COL, Enum.Material.Concrete)

	-- Streetlights: 10 pairs spaced every 45 studs along the road
	local poleXL = sideXL - SIDE_W/2 - 1   -- -15
	local poleXR = sideXR + SIDE_W/2 + 1   -- +15
	for i = 0, 9 do
		local lz = START_Z + 25 + i * 45
		buildStreetlight(folder, poleXL, lz)
		buildStreetlight(folder, poleXR, lz)
	end
end

local function inCathedralZone(x, z)

end

		CollectionService:AddTag(bot, "OMC_Bot")

		-- Simple roaming AI
		task.spawn(function()
			while bot.Parent do
				local primary = bot.PrimaryPart
				if not primary then task.wait(1) continue end

				local targetPos = Vector3.new(
					floor.Position.X + math.random(-80, 80),
					primary.Position.Y,
					floor.Position.Z + math.random(-80, 80)
				)
				local direction = (targetPos - primary.Position).Unit

				for _ = 1, 100 do
					if not bot.Parent then break end
					primary = bot.PrimaryPart
					if not primary then break end
					bot:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(primary.CFrame + (direction * 0.4))
					task.wait(0.05)
				end
				task.wait(math.random(1, 3))
			end
		end)
	end
end

return TagBot

function TagGameLogic.OnTouch(part, tagger)
    local character = part.Parent
    local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    
    if player and player ~= tagger then
        local now = tick()
        if now - lastTagTime >= TAG_COOLDOWN then
            TagGameLogic.SetTagger(player)
            print("[TAG] " .. tagger.Name .. " tagged " .. player.Name)
        end
    end
end

function TagGameLogic.SetTagger(player)
    currentTagger = player
    lastTagTime = tick()
    
    -- In a real manifestation, we would send a RemoteEvent here
    -- ReplicatedStorage.Events.TagUpdate:FireAllClients(player)
    
    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        local highlight = character:FindFirstChild("TagHighlight") or Instance.new("Highlight")
        highlight.Name = "TagHighlight"
        highlight.FillColor = AURA_COLOR
        highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        highlight.Parent = character
    end
end

-- Specialist: systems-pilot-01 | Role: Logic Orchestration
-- Mission: Sector Alpha — Tag Game (STABILITY UPGRADE)

local TagLogic = {}

-- [[ GOVERNANCE IMPORTS ]]
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local OMC = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("OMC")
local Generated = OMC:WaitForChild("Generated")
local Telemetry = require(Generated:WaitForChild("Telemetry"))

-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

-- Configuration
local CONFIG = {
	TAG_DISTANCE = 7,
	COOLDOWN = 12,
	IT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255),
	TELEMETRY_RATE = 5, -- Pulse every 5 seconds, NOT every frame
}

-- State
local currentIt = nil
local lastTagTime = {}
local totalTags = 0
local sessionStart = os.clock()
local lastPulseTime = 0

local function getTagsPerMin()
	local elapsed = os.clock() - sessionStart
	if elapsed < 10 then return 0 end
	return (totalTags / (elapsed / 60))
end

function TagLogic.assignIt(player)
	if currentIt then
		local char = currentIt.Character
		if char then
			local highlight = char:FindFirstChild("IT_Highlight")
			if highlight then highlight:Destroy() end
		end
	end

	currentIt = player
	totalTags = totalTags + 1

	local char = player.Character
	if char then
		local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		highlight.Name = "IT_Highlight"
		highlight.FillColor = CONFIG.IT_COLOR
		highlight.Parent = char
	end

	print("[OMC] New 'It' Assigned: " .. player.Name)
end

function TagLogic.start()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		if not currentIt then
			TagLogic.assignIt(player)
		end
	end)

	-- Main Game Loop
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not currentIt then return end
		local itChar = currentIt.Character
		if not itChar then return end
		local itRoot = itChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not itRoot then return end

		-- Scan Players
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player ~= currentIt then
				local char = player.Character
				if char then
					local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if root then
						local distance = (itRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
						local now = os.clock()
						local lastTag = lastTagTime[player.UserId] or 0

						if distance < CONFIG.TAG_DISTANCE and (now - lastTag) > CONFIG.COOLDOWN then
							lastTagTime[currentIt.UserId] = now
							TagLogic.assignIt(player)
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- Scan Bots (Solo Testing)
		for _, bot in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("OMC_Bot")) do
			-- Support both Model (monster) and legacy Part bots
			local botRoot = bot:IsA("Model") and bot.PrimaryPart or bot:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not botRoot then botRoot = bot:IsA("BasePart") and bot or nil end
			if botRoot then
				local distance = (itRoot.Position - botRoot.Position).Magnitude
				local now = os.clock()
				local lastTag = lastTagTime[bot] or 0

				if distance < CONFIG.TAG_DISTANCE and (now - lastTag) > CONFIG.COOLDOWN then
					lastTagTime[bot] = now
					totalTags = totalTags + 1

					-- Visual flash using Highlight
					local flash = Instance.new("Highlight")
					flash.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
					flash.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
					flash.Parent = bot
					task.delay(0.3, function() flash:Destroy() end)

					print("🤖 [TAG] Monster Bot Tagged! Frequency rising...")
				end
			end
		end

		-- [[ THROTTLED TELEMETRY DISPATCH ]]
		local now = os.clock()
		if (now - lastPulseTime) >= CONFIG.TELEMETRY_RATE then
			lastPulseTime = now
			Telemetry.dispatchPulse({
				state = "Operational",
				itPlayer = currentIt and currentIt.Name or "None",
				tagFreq = getTagsPerMin(),
				resonance = getTagsPerMin() >= 6 and "Stable" or "Dissonant"
			})
		end
	end)
end

return TagLogic
